title: Scrutiny list of Computer Operator to Assistant Director IT
text:
In continuation of the previous email dated June 3, 2026, and in line with the relevant provisions of the Statutes, the scrutinized lists pertaining to the remaining cadres of support staff are hereby communicated for information and further dissemination among all employees working under your administrative control.
It is, therefore, requested that all concerned employees may kindly be informed regarding their eligibility status accordingly.
Furthermore, in case any category is missing, the same shall be uploaded in due course of time after completion of the necessary process.
Important Note:
Those applicants who have been declared ineligible by the Scrutiny Committee may file an appeal within two weeks of the issuance of this email, as per the provisions of the Statutes. Such appeals shall be placed before the Appellate Committee in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Statutes.
It is further clarified that applicants declared ineligible by the Scrutiny Committee have not yet been marked for PER. Therefore, the zero marks appearing against their PER score may be read as “Not Applicable.”
Please note that the eligibility status is provisional and may be revoked at any time in case any document, information, or record is found to be tampered with or unverifiable.
Errors and omissions, if any, are subject to rectification.
